compute.cost_note: prepare and status are stdlib and instant. score loads a sentence-transformers embedding model (default mxbai) for the sbert distance and always adds word-set Jaccard; TF-IDF is added only with scikit-learn, and the POS-bigram metrics only with spaCy plus its en_core_web_sm model (unavailable metrics are recorded as skipped). The continuations come from the operator's own chat sessions, so the harness makes no model calls of its own

do_not_use_when: you want an automated or binary AI verdict; the harness never calls a model and the pack is uncalibrated evidence
you cannot record per-family metadata and blinding status; the pack's caveats depend on it
sentence-transformers cannot be installed (score computes the default sbert distance and stops without it)

examples.description: Prepare a run with four windows
Check which family outputs are still missing
Score the run once outputs are pasted back

required: prepare needs the target text file; status and score need the run directory
inputs.target: a target prose file (prepare) or a run directory (status, score)

artifacts: run directory with prompts, outputs/<family>/ slots and WORKFLOW.md (prepare)

purpose: Operator harness for the external-mirror discrimination method. prepare windows a target and writes ready-to-paste continuation prompts per LLM family plus a WORKFLOW.md checklist; the operator pastes each family's continuations back into the run directory; status reports what is present or missing; score runs ingest, pairwise continuation distances and the evidence pack. The pack is uncalibrated evidence, with no verdict.
use_when: you want discrimination evidence for a target by comparing how several LLM families continue its windows, alongside a human control
you can run the prompts in your own chat sessions and paste the outputs back
